title: Stat cards stacking over moody footage
summary: Four rounded stat cards rise one over another on dim monochrome footage, each a different fill with a mono label and one big figure, every 0.8 s; then a hard cut to a two-line word-by-word close on black.
use_when: A fitness, health or tracking product with three to five headline figures
Short silent social promo (4:5 feed) that has to show results in under 4 s
A metric recap where each figure gets its own colour
Footage of the activity exists but no UI recording does

look.type_style: card labels: small uppercase mono, ~1.3 % H; figures: heavy grotesk, tight tracking, ~4 % H with a smaller bold unit line under it; close: bold grotesk, sentence case, tight, ~5 % H, two centred lines with periods

sfx.event: a stat card lands on the stack
the figure appears on the landed card
each word of the close appears

structure.shot: black open (~0.2 s), then dim grey close-up footage; accent-red stat card rises in, figure lands; second black card stacks over it
structure.camera: footage drift: scale 1.00->0.98 (-1.3 %/s), cards fixed in the centre column
structure.motion: card 1 rises ~6 % H into place, springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s, overshoot not measurable); figure + unit appear 6-8 fr after the card (±0.25 s); at 1.00 card 2 rises over card 1 from ~5 % H lower, springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s); card 1 hidden behind by 1.27; pager dot 2 lights

structure.shot: same footage; white stat card with a small icon by the figure stacks over the black one, then a mid-grey card over the white
structure.motion: card 3 rises over card 2 from ~8 % H lower, springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s), figure already set on entry; card 4 enters at 2.77 the same way, unit line appears at 3.00; 0.8 s per card (24 fr); pager dots 3 then 4 light

structure.shot: flat black; two-line close, 7 words: line 1 claims the activity, line 2 tells the viewer to get the product
structure.motion: word-reveal, words appear one by one without blur at ~4 fr per word (±0.25 s), wrap to line 2 at 3.77; full by 4.00; hold 30 fr to the end

params.brand: brand.json: display font for figures and close, mono for card labels, accent for card 1
params.content.footage: one moody close-up clip of the activity, graded to monochrome and darkened
params.content.stats: 4 items {label, value, unit?, fill, icon?}; label uppercase mono, value 2-5 characters
params.content.close: 2 short lines, ≤ 4 words each, line 2 is the call to action
params.aspect: 4:5 default; 9:16 and 1:1 keep the card column centred

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Card cadence 0.27 / 1.00 / 1.80 / 2.77 s, ~0.8 s each; detected cuts at 1.80 and 3.40 are a card entrance and the cut to black. Card fills in order: accent red, black, white, mid-grey; each new card covers the previous with a slightly lower start so the old card's top edge peeks for a few frames. Vertical 4-dot pager right of the card tracks the active card. Whether figures count up is not measurable. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): stat-card-stack, pager-dots. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is silent. difficulty medium: one card component in 4 data states counted as one rebuilt screen.
